title: feat(studio): 全部类型 All types ends the 高级 fold, and the type directory lists every type a package could hold
body:
Fixes #37360
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 Studio 左侧菜单的「高级」折叠区最下面，多了一行「全部类型」；点开是类型目录页，列出六个分组里的所有类型，这个应用还没有的类型标着「还没有」，并写明在这里能否新建。
- 为什么做：属于 Studio 左侧菜单改版；替从零新建应用的开发者解决邮件模板、文档、字段映射这类东西的第一条无处新建的问题。
- 出错会怎样：打开「全部类型」的开发者可能看到某个类型的「还没有」标错；「高级」里原有的行不受影响，本改动可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么：本改动在架构决策记录里加了一句修订，需要你亲手合并或批准。

## What changes

Implements ruling **A** on #37360 (ruling record [comment 7177310364](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/37360#issuecomment-7177310364), maintainer, verbatim: 「37360 同意」).

- **The row.** On a package, the 高级 Advanced fold ends with one row, 「全部类型」 All types, below its groups and under no group's label. It opens the area's type directory (`/studio/PKG/metadata`), and on that page it is the current entry, so the fold opens by itself there without writing its cookie. A menu search lists it last when its name matches. `~org` and `~all` draw no fold and no row. The row is not part of `buildStudioMenu`'s groups, so the fold's rule does not change: a 高级 type is drawn when the package holds one, and appears there by itself once it does.
- **The directory.** On a package under Studio's area, the page lists the types the package holds exactly as before (the shared `scopeDirectoryEntries` rule is untouched, so the menu and the directory still agree on what a package holds) and, after them in each group, every other served type of the menu's six groups (`directoryNotHeldEntries`). Each of those is marked "None yet" / 「还没有」 in place of an item count, with the existing state word for what can be done there (read-only / can be customized / can be added / writable). A tile opens the type's list, which carries New. A failed diagnostics sweep says nothing about what the package holds, so then nothing is marked or added. The cross-package leg and Setup's directory list as before.
- **ADR-0084** gains one dated amendment line under "Entries that are not a type": the fifth entry, 全部类型, the fold's last row, the one entry under no group; the fold's rule stands.
- Studio catalogue keys (en, zh): `engine.studio.menu.allTypes`, `engine.directory.notHeld`, `engine.directory.notHeldTitle`, `engine.directory.notHeldReadOnlyTitle`. The palette's entry-icon map gains the new entry kind (the palette lists only the menu's groups, so it draws nothing new).

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx` — `directoryNotHeldEntries` and the `notHeldEntries` memo (the `diagError` guard), and the tile's not-held badge.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioMenu.tsx` — `renderAllTypes` inside the fold region, after `renderGroups(tiers.advanced, 'advanced')`, and `currentIsAdvanced`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuModel.ts` — `studioMenuAllTypesEntry` and the area-root branch of `studioMenuCurrentKey`.

## Tests

Pins (each ablated once, below):
- **The row exists and is last, under no group** — `StudioMenu.test.tsx` › 全部类型 All types: the last link of the fold region, after every `studio-menu-advanced-group-*`, inside no `data-sidebar="group"` and under no group label; href `/studio/PKG/metadata`. Model pins in `studioMenuModel.test.ts` (package only; in no group of the menu or either tier).
- **The directory lists held and not-held types correctly** — `DirectoryPage.allTypes-37360.test.tsx`: held types first with their counts and no mark; then each group's not-held types marked "None yet" with no count and the right state word (`api` read-only, `doc` addable, `email_template` writable); a type outside the six groups and the hidden `field` are never listed; a failed sweep marks nothing; the cross-package leg is unchanged.
- **A not-held type's tile reaches a list with New** — same file: clicking the `email_template` tile routes to `/studio/PKG/metadata/email_template?package=PKG`, where the real list page renders `metadata-list-create`.
- **CONTROL: the fold still omits a not-held type** — `StudioMenu.test.tsx` (rendered: `email_template` and `position` served, held by none, absent from the open fold while 全部类型 is there) and `studioMenuModel.test.ts` (the shared rule plus `buildStudioMenu`).

Rewritten on purpose (each marked in place): `studioMenuModel.test.ts` "nothing at the directory" → the directory's current entry is `allTypes`; `StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx` "The directory is no one entry's page" → the current link is `studio-menu-entry-allTypes`; `metadataAreaHost.scope-28561.test.tsx` kernel-package directory read "No matches" → it lists the kernel package's not-held types, scoped to it, URL unrepaired.

Ablations (one per pin, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; tests import the source by relative path, so no `dist/` is involved):

| Pin | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Row last, under no group | drop the row's render in the fold | red: `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="studio-menu-entry-allTypes"]` |
| Directory lists held + not-held | `directoryNotHeldEntries` returns nothing | red: `expected [ 'hook', 'object' ] to deeply equal [ Array(5) ]` |
| Not-held tile reaches list with New | a not-held tile links to `.` | red: the tile's `href` assertion |
| CONTROL fold omits not-held | the menu's `always` list becomes every served type | red: `expected ... to be null` on `studio-menu-entry-type:email_template` |

Readings are in the details blocks under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **The six types that cannot be created in Studio are listed, marked read-only** (the choice the ruling left to execution). Reasons: the ruling's own words are "every type of the six groups", and leaving six out would need a second hand-kept exception list beside the registry the page reads; listing them tells a builder the type exists and that its items come from code, which is the question the page answers; the page already carries the read-only word and the "Hide read-only" filter, which drops them in one click (pinned).
- **Not-held types are listed on a read-only package too**, with the same state word the page already draws there: a read-only base's New lands in its `.custom` pair (ADR-0146 D3), so the list can still make a first item.
- **A failed diagnostics sweep adds and marks nothing**: it answered nothing about what the package holds, and "None yet" on every type would be a wrong claim (pinned).
- The menu's ⌘K palette does not list 全部类型: it lists the menu's groups, and the row sits in none. Its icon map gained the kind only because the map is typed over every entry kind.
- Files beyond the claim's surface: `StudioPaletteGroups.tsx` (one icon row, required by its typed map), and two test files whose pins described the old directory (`StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx`, `metadataAreaHost.scope-28561.test.tsx`), each rewritten on purpose.
- Browser walk on a new empty package (the card's suggested end-to-end check): NOT MEASURED, reason: not run in this container; the routing from tile to list and New is pinned over the real directory and list pages in jsdom.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open Studio on a new, empty app, expand 「高级」 and click its last row 「全部类型」; expect every type under its group, e.g. 邮件模板 tile with 「还没有」 and 「可写」, and clicking it opens the empty email-template list with 「新建」.

All readings on head `45ed0a4bf5c` unless noted.
